messages:
maya: Heads-up — the post-midnight archive-pruner cron failed and that cascaded into the model-refresh job getting aborted at ~01:12. Noticed a bunch of 'Killed' OOM lines in the pruner logs.
ci-bot: cron/archive-pruner v2 - FAILED (exit 137). Logs: https://ci.internal/1234 · rerun allowed for eng-ml-admins
leo: hitting the same on my dev repro earlier — looks like the pruner shard tried to load too many index files into memory.
sam: I can kick a manual rerun, but we should decide if we want to change the shard size first. rerunning as-is may just flap.
maya: Sam, please try a manual rerun once so we have fresh CI artifacts to look at. If it fails again, we should collect a bisect range.
sam: OK kicking rerun now: https://ci.internal/1234/retry · started.
deploy-bot: manual-rerun started by sam (job 1234#retry1)
ci-bot: retry1 - RUNNING
anya: quick thought — the pruner recently added aggressive in-memory sort for candidate shards (PR #982). If memory budget not respected at scale we'll hit OOM. Can we rerun with environment var PRUNER_MAX_SHARD_BYTES=200000000 (200MB) for a smoke test?
leo: good call. Also adding a fallback to stream-sort would help until we have a proper memory guard.
sam: rerun finished — FAILED with same exit 137. stdout snippet:
```
[2026-03-17 01:11:57] shard-7 loading index files
[2026-03-17 01:12:03] Allocating 1.1GB for sort buffer
[2026-03-17 01:12:05] process killed (OOM)
```
maya: cool, we have repro on CI. Anya please submit a short patch to bound memory and I'll ship a quick revert of the aggressive sort if needed.
anya: I'll open a hotfix PR to set PRUNER_MAX_SHARD_BYTES default to 200MB and add a guard to fallback to external stream-sort. Putting WIP: https://git.internal/redwood/pruner/pulls/1011
leo: For triage: if hotfix is slow, alternative is to disable archive-pruner cron for a day and backfill with a controlled job runner that shards smaller. Which is less risky?
maya: Disabling cron for one day seems safe (we have retention margin) and buys time for a proper fix. But need approver from infra. @sam can you coordinate with infra to disable the cron window 02:00-04:00?
sam: pinged @infra-team in ops channel, asked for a scheduled pause. Also added a temporary job template we can run ad-hoc with PRUNER_MAX_SHARD_BYTES=150MB if infra can't pause quickly.
ci-bot: job 1234#retry1 artifacts: https://ci.internal/1234/artifacts/logs.tar.gz
maya: plan summary: 1) infra to pause cron for 24h or until hotfix lands. 2) Anya lands hotfix with guarded memory and stream-sort fallback. 3) run a canary manual-prune on a small tenant. 4) re-enable cron and monitor token-level errors.
anya: I'll aim for a hotfix PR and test job in the next 2 hours. If anyone has spare GPU/large-memory CI slots please flag — the pruner smoke needs ~4GB to run with current dataset.
leo: I can free up one large CI node tonight. Ping me when ready and I'll attach it to the test job.
sam: infra responded — pausing cron window for today done. Also set an alert to hold any automatic retries.
maya: thanks all. Leaving this thread open — ping here when hotfix merges and when you start the canary so I can watch the model-refresh pipeline. :thumbsup:
